summary: Exact local constrained action, Dirac reduction and nonreal scalar principal frequencies for the regular complex two-carrier metric-only comparison.

stage_events.description: Used the fixed-carrier rank result to construct a local metric and scalar chart, match the presymplectic currents, eliminate the auxiliary constraints, and compute the principal frequencies.

Checked finite auxiliary determinants, frequency discriminants and the rational affine witness with exact integer arithmetic. Added reproducible symbolic tests and finite Lean statements for repository CI.

evidence.limitations: The principal metric calculation concerns real null covectors.

evidence.limitations: The comparison uses a supplied Einstein-Hilbert metric action and independent compatible defining connection choices before any microscopic selector.
